edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: The proposed pathway is not one magic molecule but sustained cognitive stimulation, better mood, and more daily structure, all of which can help delay dementia expression.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2026 Oye-Somefun meta analysis in PLoS One already points to high social engagement tracks with lower risk or better outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
